test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that has a grammatical error.

options.text: After a tiring day, I had a cup of coffee with Sudhir.
There is a man sitting beside cat.
She saw an excellent episode of the series.
She asked an easy question, and I took an hour to crack it.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. There is a man sitting beside cat. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence has a grammatical error concerning the use of prepositions.
 
• The word "beside" should be followed by an article "a" or "the" before the noun "cat".
 
• The correct sentence should be "There is a man sitting beside a/the cat".

Correct sentence: *There is a man sitting beside **a/the cat***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Use of Prepositions:**

 
 
• **Beside:** This preposition means "next to" or "at the side of". It often needs to be followed by an article when referring to a specific noun.
 
• **Example:** She sits beside the fireplace.
 
 
 
• **Other Common Prepositions:**
 
 
• **In:** Used to indicate location or position within something.
 
• **On:** Used to indicate surface or position on a surface.
 
• **At:** Used to indicate a specific point or place.
